preheader: 12-section daily executive intelligence across markets, AI, HR, and economics.
executive_summary: The Indian stock market saw Nifty and Sensex extend their weekly gains despite an IT-led selloff, while the US stock market experienced mixed results. Globally, markets are reacting to geopolitics and economic trends, with inflation forecasted to decline worldwide, except in the US where it is accelerating. In the tech sector, major AI companies have launched new models and formed an industry body, driving advances in AI research and development. Additionally, India's job market is experiencing high mobility and layoffs, reflecting a settling trend after recent fluctuations.
